newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hill Industries plans share split.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hill Industries plans share split.

text.p: Hills Industries Ltd said on Monday it planned a share split with shareholders receiving five new shares for every one share held.
Hills chairman Bob Ling said in a statement the split was aimed at boosting liquidity in the company's shares and the company would seek shareholder approval for the split.
Ling said the par value of shares would be reduced from 50 cents to 10 cents. All current shares would be cancelled and new certificates issued if approval is received.
All shareholders will receive five new ordinary shares of 10 cents par value, for each ordinary share of 50 cents par value previously held without any payment, Ling said.
He said that the split would not change any shareholder's interest in the electronic and consumer products group.
At 1.25 p.m. (0225 GMT), Hills shares were 22 cents higher at A$7.30 on low volume.
